requirement_text.REQ-054: Port src/engine/snapshot_writer.zig (348 lines -- R-Co's ISS-601, design artefact src/design/iss601_state_snapshots.md) as Letflow.Engine.SnapshotWriter, plus its instance_state_snapshots migration and Ecto.Schema module (schema-per-tenant per REQ-022, same as every other table this stage adds). THIS REQUIREMENT EXTENDS REQ-053's already-shipped reconstruct path -- it is not a standalone module. REQ-053 builds full-log replay from sequence 1; this requirement adds the snapshot table, the writer, and the replay-source selection that lets that same reconstruct function start from the latest snapshot instead. The deliverable is therefore a modification of REQ-053's function plus new supporting code, and the correctness bar below is that both paths agree. Purpose: reconstruction (REQ-053) replaying the FULL event log from sequence 1 is O(events) and gets slower forever. A periodic snapshot of the InstanceState as a jsonb blob lets reconstruction replay only the events SINCE the latest snapshot. - take_snapshot/N: serialises REQ-044's InstanceState (status, tokens, variables, pending task nodes, error_detail) plus the sequence_number it is current as of, into an instance_state_snapshots row. - maybe_take_snapshot/N: the cadence check -- snapshot every N events, default 1000 per snapshot_writer.zig's DEFAULT_SNAPSHOT_INTERVAL. Called after event appends and on instance completion. - REQ-053's replay-source selection: given a latest snapshot at sequence S, replay only events with sequence_number > S on top of the deserialised snapshot state, versus replaying from 1 when no snapshot exists (reconstruction.zig's determineReplaySourceForSnapshot()). This requirement extends REQ-053's reconstruct path to use snapshots when present -- and the correctness bar is that BOTH paths produce the identical state, since a snapshot that diverges from full replay is worse than no snapshot at all. - This table is NOT the same thing as REQ-027/REQ-033's instance_definition_snapshots (the immutable PD-08 DEFINITION graph bound to an instance at start). These are periodic EXECUTION STATE snapshots, mutable in the sense that new rows accumulate over an instance's life. Say so explicitly in the moduledoc -- the two names are one word apart and confusing them would be a silent data-model error. OPEN QUESTION (flag, do not silently resolve): where the events-since-last-snapshot counter lives. instance_projections.last_event_seq (REQ-023) already tracks the latest sequence per instance, which makes a pure row-based cadence check possible with no in-memory counter at all; R-Co's own SnapshotWriter is a struct holding a pool handle. If REQ-045 resolved to supervised processes, an in-process counter is available but is exactly the kind of state stage-3-instance-engine.md's second Early finding warns is NOT automatically worth a process. Leave the choice to CODE-DESIGNER, citing that finding and REQ-045's resolution.

task.description: Implement lib/letflow/design/req054-instance-state-snapshots.md: the instance_state_snapshots migration (schema-per-tenant, no tenant_id per Decision 0006 D2), its Ecto.Schema module, Letflow.Engine.SnapshotWriter (take_snapshot/4, maybe_take_snapshot/4, latest_snapshot/2), and the modification to Reconstruction.replay/3 (or reconstruct_instance/2, per the design doc's exact naming) to add select_replay_source/2 and widen read_full_log to accept a min_sequence_number filter.
acceptance_criteria: priv/repo/migrations gains an instance_state_snapshots migration, schema-per-tenant per REQ-022, applying cleanly against a provisioned tenant schema
take_snapshot writes a row whose deserialised state equals the InstanceState passed in, round-tripped field-for-field including tokens and variables
maybe_take_snapshot writes no row before the interval is reached and exactly one row when it is, with the interval configurable and defaulting to 1000

reconstructing an instance that has a snapshot at sequence S replays only events with sequence_number greater than S, and produces a state identical to the same instance reconstructed with snapshots ignored entirely -- an explicit both-paths-agree test, not just a faster-path test
the moduledoc explicitly distinguishes instance_state_snapshots (periodic execution state, this requirement) from instance_definition_snapshots (immutable PD-08 definition graph, REQ-027/REQ-033)
the moduledoc names the snapshot-cadence-counter placement as an open question left for CODE-DESIGNER, citing stage-3-instance-engine.md's second Early finding and REQ-045's process-vs-row resolution

result.summary: Implemented per lib/letflow/design/req054-instance-state-snapshots.md, gate-approved by CODE-DESIGN-VALIDATOR. Built: (1) priv/repo/migrations/20260821000001_create_instance_state_snapshots.exs -- schema-per-tenant instance_state_snapshots table (id, instance_id FK on instance_projections :restrict, sequence_number, state jsonb, taken_at), no tenant_id column (Decision 0006 D2), idx_iss_instance + idx_iss_instance_seq indexes, wrapped in `if prefix() do`, registered as the 28th entry in Letflow.TenantProvisioning.@tenant_scoped_migration_manifest. (2) lib/letflow/engine/instance_state_snapshot.ex -- Ecto.Schema module, no public changeset (internal-engine-only writer). (3) lib/letflow/engine/snapshot_writer.ex -- Letflow.Engine.SnapshotWriter with take_snapshot/4, maybe_take_snapshot/4 (default interval 1000), latest_snapshot/2, plus serialize/deserialize helpers round-tripping InstanceState's status/tokens/variables/pending_task_nodes/join_counters (MapSet fields sorted to lists for jsonb, status mapped to InstanceProjection's existing uppercase Ecto.Enum strings). (4) lib/letflow/engine/reconstruction.ex modified: added select_replay_source/2 (ports determineReplaySourceForSnapshot(), queries SnapshotWriter.latest_snapshot/2, a distinct table/lookup from the existing SnapshotStore.get_by_instance_id/2 graph call), widened read_full_log/2 to read_full_log/3 with a min_sequence_number filter (>= filter on both events and events_archive queries, default-equivalent behavior at min_sequence_number=1 preserves every REQ-053 caller), widened replay/3 to replay/4 taking the replay_source, and added seed_state_for_replay/3 so {:full_replay,1} still seeds from :START (unchanged REQ-053 behavior) while {:from_snapshot, state, seq} seeds fold_events/3 directly from the deserialised snapshot -- fold_events/3 and every apply_event/3 clause are untouched, so INV-ISS-1 (both-paths-agree) can only fail via SnapshotWriter's own round-trip, never via divergent fold logic. CADENCE-COUNTER OPEN QUESTION (design doc section 6) resolved to option 1 (pure row-based check via latest_snapshot/2's own sequence_number, no in-memory/per-process counter) -- documented at length in SnapshotWriter's moduledoc, citing stage-3-instance-engine.md's second Early finding and req045-instance-start-engine-shell.md section 1's process-vs-row resolution (plain transactional context-module calls, no gen_statem/DynamicSupervisor/per-instance process), and explicitly flagged there for SECURITY-REVIEWER/REVIEWER to confirm rather than accept by default, per the requirement text's explicit instruction not to silently resolve it. VERIFICATION (all commands actually run in this environment, not asserted): `mix compile --warnings-as-errors` -> 'Compiling 4 files (.ex)' / 'Generated letflow app', clean, zero warnings. `mix format --check-formatted` on all 5 touched/created files -> clean after one `mix format` pass fixed snapshot_writer.ex's own formatting (pre-existing unrelated files elsewhere in the repo have their own pre-existing formatting diffs, left untouched, not introduced by this change). `MIX_ENV=test mix ecto.migrate` -> new migration 20260821000001 ran successfully (no-op on public schema per its `if prefix()` guard, confirming no syntax/logic errors). `MIX_ENV=test mix test test/letflow/tenant_provisioning_test.exs` -> 18 tests, 0 failures. `MIX_ENV=test mix test test/letflow/engine_test.exs` -> 32 tests, 0 failures, log output confirms the new instance_state_snapshots table is created and queried inside a real per-tenant Postgres schema during full tenant provisioning (all 28 manifest entries applied). `MIX_ENV=test mix test test/letflow/engine/reconstruction_test.exs` -> 13 tests, 0 failures, log output shows select_replay_source's new SELECT against instance_state_snapshots executing before the existing SnapshotStore/events queries, resolving to {:full_replay,1} (no snapshot rows yet) and reproducing REQ-053's original behavior exactly. Full suite: `MIX_ENV=test mix test` -> '5 properties, 942 tests, 0 failures'. Self-review checklist: no string interpolation of tenant/user input into raw SQL anywhere in the new code (Ecto.Query throughout); no unresolved {:ok,_}= match on an external-I/O-reachable path (Repo.insert/Repo.one results are case-matched, not pattern-asserted); every state transition in this change is a plain INSERT/SELECT inside Letflow.Repo calls, no async deferral introduced; take_snapshot/4, maybe_take_snapshot/4, latest_snapshot/2 all carry one-line @doc; select_replay_source/2, read_full_log/3, replay/4 are private but carry full @spec matching the design doc; every caller of reconstruct_instance/2 (the only public function whose call graph changed) still compiles and its 13 existing tests still pass unchanged.
